content:
Russian institute (TsAGI) investigates use of electric discharges (plasma generators) on aerodynamic models in wind tunnels to study effects like drag reduction in supersonic and hypersonic airflows. This could explain why we see Winged/Glowing crafts across Europe. #ufotwitter

The paper by Russian Central Aerodynamic Institute (TsAGI) perfectly explains what type of vehicles we are seeing around the world. The United States, Lockheed Martin and Charles Chase also has papers and patents for this technology, and perhaps some other countries as well.
